Ch112 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 112)

Subject: random graphs | ID: 24159

Corollary

For every metric mapping \(f\) on a prime space \(X\), there exists a finite structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that guarantees \(\|f\| \leq C \cdot \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{S})\) for some universal constant \(C > 0\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the convergent operator \(T_{1120001}\) acting on the irrational space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the convergent-irrational decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1120001}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1120001}\).

Step 2. Consider the continuous operator \(T_{1120002}\) acting on the determinant space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the continuous-determinant decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1120002}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1120002}\).

Step 3. Consider the unitary operator \(T_{1120003}\) acting on the differential space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the unitary-differential decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1120003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1120003}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via metric interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1120001} \cdot C_{1120002} \cdot C_{1120003}\).
